review: Checked against the linked public agency pages. These are discovery names, not a claim of active service, a provider-ID mapping, or a walking route. Exact canonical-name matches retain every candidate; missing names fail closed. Personal home/work meanings remain client-owned.

coverageAliases.name: SF
coverageAliases.basis: 511 SF Bay regional coverage; SF is a discovery shortcut, not a city-only service boundary.

coverageAliases.name: San Francisco
coverageAliases.basis: San Francisco is included in the named Bay Area coverage.

coverageAliases.name: Bay Area
coverageAliases.basis: 511 describes the San Francisco Bay Area region.

places.name: Pier 39
places.basis: SFMTA explicitly labels this public stop Pier 39. No 511 stop ID or opposite-direction stop is inferred.

places.name: San Francisco International Airport
places.basis: BART's public station page and abbreviation reference identify these airport station names. Airport terminal stops that already contain SFO remain separate candidates; no airport-wide equivalence or terminal walk is invented. BART publishes its airport station in the 511 feed as "SFO"; bart.gov lists it as San Francisco International Airport (SFO).

places.name: Union Square
places.basis: BART describes Powell St station as serving Union Square; SFMTA names its Central Subway station Union Square/Market Street. 511 publishes them as Powell (BART and Muni Metro) and Union Square/Market St Station Northbound/Southbound. Stops whose own names include Union Square stay candidates.

places.name: San Francisco Caltrain station (4th and King)
places.basis: Caltrain's San Francisco station at 4th and King streets, published by 511 as Caltrain 4th & King.

places.name: Salesforce Transit Center
places.basis: The Salesforce Transit Center replaced the Transbay Terminal and is still widely called Transbay; 511 publishes it as Salesforce Transit Center.

places.name: Powell Street station
places.basis: BART's Powell St. station (shared with Muni Metro) is published by 511 as Powell. Cable car stops whose own names include Powell St stay candidates.
